# OSTF score schemas

The unmodified 5.1 score, Manifest 1.1 and Production 0.4 schemas and `26-midi-comp.ostf` are from the [official CC0 release](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-5.1/tree/957bd071cecc58a12f417ad212c40723ba9812ca).

Open Song Timeline Format by yoh-nak. These schemas ship with Studio for offline score import.

- [OSTF 3.5.0](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-3.5/tree/468ebdd) is unmodified and distributed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Copyright 2026 yoh-nak.
- The 4.0.0 structural schema was derived from the [CC0 4.1.0 schema](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-4.1/tree/f6a2695) by removing the added direction and pitch-range definitions and references, setting the version constant and removing document annotations. Its validation rules match the [official 4.0.0 schema](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-4.0/tree/c4ee64f).
- The unmodified [4.1.0](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-4.1/tree/f6a2695), [4.2.0](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-4.2/tree/7de4f27), [4.3.0](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-4.3/tree/df376f2) and [5.0.0](https://github.com/yoh-nak/Open-Song-Timeline-Format-5.0/tree/d8ce48c) schemas are from the respective official releases. See their accompanying notices and [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
